data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 69b5b5924068e145142116145736bb2844662c6e
* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso v1.17.17
* **Context Scope:** worktree-20260522-142331, epic d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6
* **Active Configs:** APPROACH_RESOLUTION=autonomous, SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per the `SUB-AGENT-GUARD` in `plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md` and the sprint orchestration flow, `/dso:implementation-plan` must be invoked via the `Skill` tool by the sprint orchestrator in the main session — never dispatched as a sub-agent via the `Agent` tool. The sprint Phase B flow "layer-stratify → parallel dispatch (≤3/layer)" refers to sequential `Skill` tool invocations, not parallel `Agent` dispatches.

#### Actual Behavior

The sprint orchestrator dispatched `/dso:implementation-plan` as three parallel `Agent` sub-agents (one per Layer 4 story) using `subagent_type: "general-purpose"`. Because the `Agent` tool IS available inside sub-agents (all agent types have `*` tools), the `SUB-AGENT-GUARD` did not fire. One of those sub-agent impl-plan runs (for story `39b8-09c6-cbca-4830`) partially succeeded, creating 2 orphan tasks (`06fd-4e70-1880-4666`, `f8bc-641d-2169-465f`) before the user interrupted the session. Those tasks had to be manually deleted.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Orchestrator dispatched three parallel `Agent(subagent_type="general-purpose", ...)` calls wrapping `/dso:implementation-plan` invocations for stories 0801, 60d1, 39b8
  * User rejected all three Agent tool calls
  * User identified orphan tasks on 39b8 (`06fd`, `f8bc`) from a prior session's erroneous sub-agent dispatch
  * Tasks deleted via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket delete <id> --user-approved`
* **Known Workarounds:** Invoke `/dso:implementation-plan` via `Skill` tool sequentially from the main orchestrator session — never via `Agent` tool.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** `/dso:sprint` Phase B (Task Analysis / Implementation Planning Gate)
* **Skills Invoked:** `/dso:implementation-plan`, `Agent` tool (incorrectly)

### 7. Additional Details

Root cause (observable symptom only, no speculation): the sprint SKILL.md Phase B flow description "parallel dispatch (≤3/layer)" does not specify the dispatch mechanism. The orchestrator misread this as an `Agent` tool dispatch when it must be sequential `Skill` tool invocations. The `SUB-AGENT-GUARD` in impl-plan does not protect against this because all agent types receive `*` tool access, so `Agent` tool availability cannot distinguish sub-agent context from orchestrator context.

Fix area: clarify in `/dso:sprint` Phase B that "parallel dispatch" means the orchestrator runs impl-plan for each story via the `Skill` tool in sequence (not via Agent sub-agents), and that the ≤3/layer cap governs the number of stories planned per sprint iteration, not concurrent agent execution.
data.title: /dso:sprint Phase B: dispatch implementation-plan as Agent sub-agent -> deeply nested sub-agent calls + orphan tasks
